summary_instruction: Summarize based on Reviews: Genshin Impact's open-world exploration is breathtaking and deeply immersive across every new region, though traveling long distances without an active stamina buff can sometimes feel tedious. The artifact grinding system remains utterly frustrating and heavily dependent on unfair RNG layers, forcing players to dump weeks of resin without a single usable piece. Combat mechanics feel remarkably fluid and responsive with elemental reactions, but the mobile camera lock-on feature is notoriously clunky during crowded Abyss encounters. The orchestral soundtrack composed for each distinct nation is genuinely world-class, elevating cutscenes and ambient roaming into emotional highlights. The gacha pity system is fairly predictable for limited characters, but the weapon banner remains predatory and punishing for low-spend players. Co-op multiplayer functionality feels severely restricted and underbaked, as visiting friends cannot open chests, talk to key NPCs, or advance world quests together.; Aspects: {'aspect': 'open-world exploration', 'opinion': 'breathtaking and deeply immersive', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'artifact grinding system', 'opinion': 'frustrating and heavily dependent on unfair RNG layers', 'sentiment': 'Negative'} {'aspect': 'combat mechanics', 'opinion': 'fluid and responsive', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'mobile camera lock-on feature', 'opinion': 'notoriously clunky', 'sentiment': 'Negative'} {'aspect': 'orchestral soundtrack', 'opinion': 'genuinely world-class', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'weapon banner', 'opinion': 'predatory and punishing', 'sentiment': 'Negative'} {'aspect': 'co-op multiplayer functionality', 'opinion': 'severely restricted and underbaked', 'sentiment': 'Negative'}
target: Genshin Impact offers a breathtaking and deeply immersive open-world exploration, with the mobile camera lock-on feature being notoriously clunky. The orchestral soundtrack is world-class, while the weapon banner is predatory and punishing, though the co-op multiplayer functionality is severely restricted and underbaked.

summary_instruction: Summarize based on Reviews: Zenless Zone Zero delivers stylish animations with exceptionally punchy combat impacts that make basic dodge-counters and chain attacks feel incredibly rewarding. The original TV grid navigation mode was painfully slow and broke the momentum of gameplay, though recent patch adjustments made it much more bearable. Character designs and distinct urban aesthetics are bursting with personality, easily standing out among modern action-oriented anime titles. The hip-hop and electronic background music provides energetic rhythm that matches the frenetic tempo of Hollow combat encounters flawlessly. Hollow Zero rogue-lite mode progression becomes repetitive and tedious once weekly point quotas are cleared, offering little build diversity. summary_instruction: Summarize based on Reviews: Elden Ring offers an astonishing sense of freedom and world discovery through the Lands Between, constantly rewarding curious players with hidden catacombs and unique armaments. PC port optimization suffers from noticeable stuttering issues and lack of native ultrawide support, which disrupts what should otherwise be a seamless boss encounter. Boss encounter difficulty strikes an exhilarating balance between brutal punishment and intense satisfaction once attack telegraph patterns are mastered. Build variety and weapon ash of war customization provide virtually infinite replayability, allowing wildly different playstyles across successive playthroughs. Questline tracking remains deliberately opaque and confusing without external wiki guides, causing players to accidentally lock out major NPC stories. Legacy dungeon level design showcases masterclass environmental architecture with intricate shortcuts that reward methodical exploration.; Aspects: {'aspect': 'world discovery', 'opinion': 'sense of freedom', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'PC port optimization', 'opinion': 'noticeable stuttering issues', 'sentiment': 'Negative'} {'aspect': 'boss encounter difficulty', 'opinion': 'exhilarating balance', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'build variety', 'opinion': 'infinite replayability', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'questline tracking', 'opinion': 'deliberately opaque', 'sentiment': 'Negative'} {'aspect': 'legacy dungeon level design', 'opinion': 'masterclass environmental architecture', 'sentiment': 'Positive'}
target: Elden Ring offers an immersive world discovery, but PC port optimization struggles with noticeable stuttering issues. The questline is deliberately opaque, locking out NPC stories. The boss encounter difficulty strikes an exhilarating balance between punishment and satisfaction. Build variety and weapon customization provide virtually infinite replayability, allowing players to unlock different playstyles across playthroughs. Legacy dungeon level design showcases masterclass environmental architecture with intricate shortcuts.

summary_instruction: Summarize based on Reviews: Cyberpunk 2077's Night City environment presents an unmatched level of atmospheric detail and visual grandeur, especially with full path tracing enabled on high-end hardware. Pedestrian AI behavior still feels immersion-breaking and lifeless when wandering off the designated story tracks into less detailed back alleys. Narrative storytelling and voice acting deliver an emotionally gripping journey that makes the main cast of characters memorable long after the credits roll. Vehicle handling physics and high-speed driving mechanics feel floaty and unresponsive on keyboard controls during tight street chases. Cyberware progression and perk tree overhaul offer cohesive character builds, turning late-game mercenary combat into a power fantasy. Police response system logic still spawns law enforcement unnaturally close to the player rather than delivering realistic vehicular pursuit.; Aspects: {'aspect': 'Night City environment', 'opinion': 'unmatched level of atmospheric detail', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'pedestrian AI behavior', 'opinion': 'immersion-breaking', 'sentiment': 'Negative'} {'aspect': 'narrative storytelling', 'opinion': 'emotionally gripping', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'voice acting', 'opinion': 'emotionally gripping', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'vehicle handling physics', 'opinion': 'floaty and unresponsive', 'sentiment': 'Negative'} {'aspect': 'cyberware progression', 'opinion': 'cohesive character builds', 'sentiment': 'Positive'} {'aspect': 'police response system logic', 'opinion': 'unnaturally close', 'sentiment': 'Negative'}
target: Cyberpunk 2077's night city offers an exceptional atmosphere, with full path tracing enhancing the visuals. Despite occasional immersion-breaking behavior in AI, the narrative storytelling is emotionally compelling, with memorable voice acting and vehicle physics issues.
